title: Jamaican Vibes Salad
description: A fresh and vibrant Jamaican-inspired salad made with mixed greens, vegetables, and a hint of Caribbean spices.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, combine mixed greens, sliced red onions, and chopped peppers.
2. In a small bowl, whisk together vegetable oil and vibrant lime juice.
3. Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to coat.
4. Chill in the refrigerator for 30 minutes.
5. Serve the salad garnished with additional peppers and a sprinkle of lime juice.
